description: While asking clarifying questions to build a new CEO buyer persona, phrased a question as 'Which service line(s) is this CEO persona primarily selling into?' which reversed the buyer/seller relationship — the CEO is the target being sold TO, not an entity selling a service line.
correction: David corrected: 'Stop. We are selling TO the CEO persona. Do not reverse this.' Buyer personas represent the target/buyer; Improving's service lines are what gets pitched to the persona, not something the persona sells.
systemic_fix: When drafting buyer/ICP persona questions, frame service line as 'which service line(s) will we pitch to this persona' rather than language implying the persona sells or delivers that service.
